query: SELECT id, jobId, engine, query, isCited, LEFT(snippet, 200) as snippet_preview, LEFT(responseText, 300) as response_preview, JSON_LENGTH(allCitedUrls) as cited_url_count, JSON_EXTRACT(allCitedUrls, '$[0]') as first_cited_url FROM citation_checks WHERE isCited = 'no' AND allCitedUrls IS NOT NULL AND JSON_LENGTH(allCitedUrls) > 0 LIMIT 5;
